facts.text: The OpenCodeReview workflow (`.github/workflows/ocr-review.yml`) runs on `pull_request_target` and treats PR code as untrusted: only the trusted base SHA is checked out, the PR head is fetched only for diff/OCR inspection, and no PR-provided action, script, build, test, install, or OCR rule runs. The review is advisory.

Trebol relies on Pi's native CodeMode tool instead of a custom `codemode` registration, per the v0.6.0 changelog entry; `README.md` enables it via `defaultTools: ["+codemode"]` in `.pi/settings.json`.

The `/trebol-toggle` command and `ctrl+n` shortcut both live in `extensions/trebol-toggle/index.ts` (`registerCommand` and `registerShortcut`), and the command's description says it toggles Trebol extensions and reloads the runtime.

The running-work drawer is drawn in the conversation-metrics footer (`AGENTS.md`, extensions/conversation-metrics/extension.ts), while its keyboard input is routed by `handleRunningWorkInput` from `.pi/lib/ui/running-work.ts` through the swarm-themes editor (`extensions/swarm-themes/extension.ts`).
The ask-user question UI is a Pi custom UI surface, opened through `ctx.ui.custom` in `extensions/ask-user/src/answer-commands.ts`.

The running-work browser (`openRunningWorkView` in `.pi/lib/ui/running-work-view.ts`) opens through `ctx.ui.custom`. Its file comment says it is a non-overlay custom UI that replaces the prompt editor, not a centered overlay. Escape is matched with `matchesKey(data, "escape")`.

Subagent transcript paths flow from `packages/tools/agents/src/index.ts` (`onTranscriptPath` and `transcriptSinks`) into `.pi/lib/tools/swarm-agent-tools.ts`, which passes `transcriptPath` to `setRunningWork` during and after execution.

Background Bash (`.pi/lib/tools/swarm-bgprocess.ts`) registers a `kind: "bash"` running-work item labelled `params.description` or "Background Bash", with a `readOutput` returning the last 160 lines. On completion it re-registers with the command as label and the last 12 output lines.
